\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 210-213 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:PT-R218-first-pass-words-from-chapters-210-213}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a platform and a passport.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item flu, a prescription; a recipe, a tablet, a syrup, an ointment
  \item patience, luck, a bone, an allergy, a headache
  \item the end, the beginning, a deadline, a period, a public holiday
  \item inside, outside, the interior, a border, a region
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Flu? (\textbf{a gripe}.) A prescription; a recipe? (\textbf{a receita}.) A tablet? (\textbf{o comprimido}.) A syrup? (\textbf{o xarope}.) An ointment? (\textbf{a pomada}.) Patience? (\textbf{a paciência}.) Luck? (\textbf{a sorte}.) A bone? (\textbf{o osso}.) An allergy? (\textbf{a alergia}.) A headache? (\textbf{a dor de cabeça}.) The end? (\textbf{o fim}.) The beginning? (\textbf{o início}.) A deadline? (\textbf{o prazo}.) A period? (\textbf{a época}.) A public holiday? (\textbf{o feriado}.) Inside? (\textbf{dentro}.) Outside? (\textbf{fora}.) The interior? (\textbf{o interior}.) A border? (\textbf{a fronteira}.) A region? (\textbf{a região}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 214-218 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:PT-R218-second-pass-words-from-chapters-214-218}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for only and together.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item only, together, nevertheless, perhaps, besides
  \item jealous, proud, nervous, quiet, silent
  \item free of charge, modern, ancient, spicy, raw
  \item divorced, cloudy, sunny, rainy, fat
  \item breakfast, a snack, a tip, a platform, a passport
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Only? (\textbf{apenas}.) Together? (\textbf{juntos / juntas}.) Nevertheless? (\textbf{contudo}.) Perhaps? (\textbf{talvez}.) Besides? (\textbf{aliás}.) Jealous? (\textbf{ciumento / ciumenta}.) Proud? (\textbf{orgulhoso / orgulhosa}.) Nervous? (\textbf{nervoso / nervosa}.) Quiet? (\textbf{tranquilo / tranquila}.) Silent? (\textbf{silencioso / silenciosa}.) Free of charge? (\textbf{gratuito / gratuita}.) Modern? (\textbf{moderno / moderna}.) Ancient? (\textbf{antigo / antiga}.) Spicy? (\textbf{picante}.) Raw? (\textbf{cru / crua}.) Divorced? (\textbf{divorciado / divorciada}.) Cloudy? (\textbf{nublado / nublada}.) Sunny? (\textbf{solarengo / solarenga}.) Rainy? (\textbf{chuvoso / chuvosa}.) Fat? (\textbf{gordo / gorda}.) Breakfast? (\textbf{o pequeno-almoço}.) A snack? (\textbf{o lanche}.) A tip? (\textbf{a gorjeta}.) A platform? (\textbf{o cais}.) A passport? (\textbf{o passaporte}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
